name: B10-0334/2025 (Renew) – Arbitrary arrest and torture of Belgian-Portuguese researcher Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary arrest and torture of Belgian-Portuguese researcher Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the immediate release of Joseph Figueira Martin, a Belgian-Portuguese humanitarian worker held in the Central African Republic for over a year without trial. It says he was kidnapped, tortured and is in poor health. It asks the Central African Republic to let him be evacuated for medical care and to give him a fair trial. It also urges the European Union to push diplomatically for his release, working with Belgium and Portugal.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's demand and request, not a decision.
- **Who it affects:** Joseph Figueira Martin, his family, and the Belgian and Portuguese governments.
- **What happens next:** The EU's foreign policy chief is asked to step up talks with the Central African Republic to secure his release.
